title: The Latent Camera
claim: Agnostic metrology: read the COST-of-digestion as a SIGNAL of latent structure. Not benchmarking, not efficiency -- measuring the cost FUNCTIONAL.

title: The COIN (honesty law)
claim: rendered_sharpness <= measured_bits. Blur is the badge. Sharpness < 1 always. Never render a fake bit.
demotions: 'zero prior art' KILLED -> structurally the reject-option/abstention family (Chow 1970)

title: V1 - prior dissolve
claim: Echo-codelength: content dissolves as context is handed over (rho on PRIOR).

title: V2 - effort sweep
claim: Reasoning-effort axis: dissolve as the observer thinks harder (the Latent Olympics).

title: V3 - 3-lab Olympics
claim: gpt-5.5 / Claude / gemini agree perfectly; the random-stone floor is PROVIDER-INVARIANT (the pinned relational bit).

title: V4 - cost ~ WORK
claim: partial-Spearman(reasoning_tokens, work | display_length) = +0.894 (p=0.0003, n=180). Effort tracks arithmetic WORK net of input length.
demotions: 'reasoning DEPTH' -> 'arithmetic WORK' (codex+gemini); the output-transcription reading (~6 tok/op) is unbeaten at this stage

title: Tier-sweep - NEED-driven
claim: The work-slope survives at low effort (rho=+0.889 ~ +0.852 high) -> NEED-driven, NOT a fixed-high-budget artifact. Budget-gate alternative killed.

title: V5 - serial-dependency surcharge
claim: Matched DEEP/WIDE (only span differs): DEEP costs +38.5 median tok > WIDE (15/16, p=0.0003). Serial structure costs extra -> REFUTES literal transcription.
demotions: 'serial DEPTH' -> 'a long serial/cross-routed dependency cost, not isolated from carry-length/routing/m/value-transcription' (codex+gemini); ~constant across span-gap = no clean dose-response

title: V6 - additive-factors (chronometric)
claim: Sternberg 2x2 (encode x depth): large additive main effects (+23/+67 tok) + a BORDERLINE interaction (+8.5 tok; bootstrap CI excl 0 BUT exact order-stat CI [0,13]; sign-p 0.065). The apparatus transfers; staged cognition NOT identified (n=12; additivity != separable cognition).
demotions: OVERCLAIM 'chronometric method reproduces / ~90% additive / validation load-bearing' -> 'apparatus transfers; borderline interaction; staged cognition not identified' (gemini+codex converged)
post-hoc pivot away from the pre-registered 'super-additive -> demote' verdict = salvage; decisive next = codex's irrelevant-expression control, NOT seed-escalation

title: V6b - compute vs transcription (control)
claim: Irrelevant-expression control (E0 / E3dead-text-present-ignored / E3live-must-compute): text-cost +5.5 vs compute-cost +14.5 tok (both p<.001, n=32, gemini-verified, conservative lower bound). CORE (both reviewers): reasoning_tokens are NOT pure literal transcription for the encode factor -- showing the expr DEAD does not induce the cost of EVALUATING it. The worry that dogged V4-V6 is rejected on the encode axis.
demotions: '~73% compute' is a within-design DESCRIPTIVE split, not a mechanistic constant (codex); E3live-E3dead bundles evaluation + assignment-vs-comment semantics + the instruction
only PARTIALLY rehabilitates V4's work-slope; says NOTHING about V5's span (needs its own dead-chain control); single model/tier/n=16

title: V5b - dead-chain: span IS compute
claim: Dead-chain control (base/dead/live x D): chain-text-cost ~FLAT (+13-16 regardless of depth) but chain-compute-cost SCALES with depth (+12@D4 -> +63.5@D12, p<.001). Executing the serial chain is real computation scaling with the critical path -> V5's span surcharge is NOT transcription. Robust (live is the SHORTER prompt than dead). WITH V6b: reasoning_tokens respond to required EXECUTION on BOTH the encode AND span axes -- the pure INPUT-text/prompt-copy account rejected across the single-observer octave.
demotions: 'transcription-proof' DEMOTED (codex): V5b rejects INPUT-text transcription but does NOT exclude hidden EXECUTION-TRACE transcription (one latent line per step shows the same depth slope); honest claim = reasoning_tokens scale with required serial WORK not input text; 'compute vs writing-it-down' may be the same act for an autoregressive model

title: V7 - burial gradient (Pav): reading not compute
claim: Burial gradient (fixed core + k labelled distractors): burying the needle costs MORE reasoning tokens (k0=48 -> 66) and climbs with k -- but it's a READING/attention tax (inert-k0 climbs +12->+16.5), NOT a compute tax (ops~inert, p=.6; the model IGNORES labelled distractors). reasoning_tokens = compute-on-the-required-path + a reading overhead proportional to total material. Pav's 'the more you bury it, the more compute?' = yes-more-reading (k0->k6), not-more-compute.
demotions: 'no compute tax' -> 'no DETECTABLE compute tax' for LABELLED, length-confounded distractors; camouflaged burial untested (easy-mode, 'track only s')
the VOLUME dose-response is WEAK (codex): inert12-inert6 median +4, p~.45 -- only the k0->k6 jump is solid; 'climbs with how much you bury it' not established k6->k12

title: V8 - camouflage rung (adversarial burial)
claim: First ADVERSARIAL-burial rung (Pav's expansion: burial as attention-manipulation/content-gravity/fake-news/encryption; the design-workflow audit caught+fixed an execution confound first). PRIMARY value-proximity camouflage (MAX_TIGHT-MAX_WIDE) = NULL (-6.5, p=.45, 100% acc both): the model is ROBUST to value-proximity camouflage -- computes & compares EXACTLY, so a needle beating the runner-up by 1 costs the same as by 40. The dominant cost is FORCED EVALUATION (SUM-LABEL=+170): being unable to surface-SKIP the needle. Find-cost is set by skip-vs-must-evaluate, NOT value-similarity.
demotions: KEEP: V8 falsifies the pre-registered VALUE-GAP camouflage prediction (gpt-5.5@high). DEMOTE 'robust to camouflage' -> 'robust to final-VALUE proximity on EXACT arithmetic' (gap knob wrong op for exact-integer; 999>998 no harder than 988>925) -- gemini+codex

DEMOTE 'forced-evaluation = the real camouflage tax' -> 'removing a skip route exposes the already-known eval cost' (interpretation, not the V8 result); 'no compute tax' -> 'no DETECTED value-gap tax, not zero' (no equivalence bound, n=16, Lakens 2017); content-gravity/attention + global-substrate/no-frame rungs UNTESTED

title: V9 - content-gravity/attention (the resistance tax)
claim: Adversarial-burial mech 2: don't HIDE the needle, make a WRONG chain attractive (SALIENT formatting / false INJECT hint 'the answer is X'). NO CAPTURE: 20/20 acc + 0/20 capture in ALL conds -- gpt-5.5@high never follows the lure, it verifies+resists. BUT a false hint costs +274 reasoning tokens (223->512, p<.001) = the cost of RESISTANCE; salient formatting only +10. The adversarial tax is in FIND-COST, not errors. A cheap-to-inject / expensive-to-refute TRAPDOOR -- the 'overthinking-attack' DoS = Pav's two-sided asymmetry, in the ATTACKER's favor. First adversarial mechanism with a large clean effect.
demotions: KEEP (narrow): 60/60 correct, 0 captures, false-hint -> large paired token spike that SATURATES the 512 reasoning ceiling (15/20 clipped). DEMOTE '+274 resistance tax' -> 'CLIPPED LOWER BOUND; override cost unmeasured + NOT isolated (need TRUE-hint control vs generic-hint/contradiction/sycophancy)' -- gemini+codex

DEMOTE 'robust to being fooled' -> 'no capture on a SHORT, EASY, WEAK-lure task' (lure=largest-non-prime, all even/small-factor, trivially rejectable; prime-looking semiprime might capture); 'trapdoor PROVEN' -> 'candidate reasoning-AVAILABILITY asymmetry, OverThink-style (2502.02542), not isolated'; it's a misleading IN-PROMPT hint not prompt-injection. Next=V9b: TRUE_HINT + prime-looking lure + cap>512 + n>=50 + cross-model

SUPERSEDED by V9b (corroborated): 512 was the HIGH-tier reasoning BUDGET not a max_tokens cap (xhigh un-clips to ~6144). The clipped +274 -> a clean +302 false-vs-NEUTRAL override tax (un-clipped, p<.001, 14/14). 'robust' -> a prime-looking lure CAPTURES 12/112 (p=0.029). NB +438 FALSE-vs-TRUE is NOT pure override (true hint shortcuts) -- needs the V9c negative-hint control

title: Cost(N) = work + span + C(N)
claim: Scaling to a collective adds ONE axis: coordination C(N), ~O(N^2) vs linear work -> a finite optimum rung ALWAYS exists (3-4 agents now, Dunbar 150, planetary for prices).

title: The two invariant floors
claim: No coordination tech dissolves: (1) Brent SPAN (=V5 absolute); (2) the Data Processing Inequality -- a handoff only LOSES truth. The DPI floor = our honesty law lifted to the collective (skeptic: 'the one genuinely-new robust claim').

title: The kernel breathes
claim: Every coordination tech (cut c / externalize memory / drown f) re-canonizes the kernel: band->firm->M-form->network->platform->swarm. The kernel grows as c falls, shrinks as f reasserts.

title: Agents INVERT humans
claim: Cloning is ~free for agents -> the constraint flips from 'how many can I afford' (kernels grew) to 'how many can I coordinate' (kernels SHRINK). Forked agents are correlated -> ensembling buys less.

title: The collective-V5 (handle)
claim: PLANNED: measure Cost(N) across N x {mesh, star, blackboard}; fit C(N); read off the swarm's Amdahl-f. Photograph Brooks + Amdahl in token-currency.

title: Total = USE + MAINTAIN + BUILD
claim: Pav's completion: the per-use cost is only the tip. Three terms on three clocks -- USE (now) + MAINTAIN (continuous) + BUILD (amortized over eons).

title: BUILD = Bennett logical depth
claim: The eons of build-cost = decompression time, not description length. The Slow-Growth Law: organized depth cannot be fast-forwarded -- it can only accumulate.

title: MAINTAIN = rent vs the 2nd law
claim: Standing dissipation holds a low-entropy structure from decaying. Metabolism scales sublinearly (Kleiber M^3/4) but the BRAIN scales linearly (fixed energy per neuron) -- the computing organ is the expensive one.

title: Amortization: easy = pre-paid
claim: USE is cheap BECAUSE BUILD was paid. 'Easy' = difficulty amortized into the infrastructure. In COIN terms: the build cost IS the pre-rendered measured_bits; cheap inference is replay. Substrate sets which term dominates (biology: build>>; popular LLM: maintain>>).

title: The backward camera (handle)
claim: PLANNED: point the camera backward in time -- a prequential/MDL read scoring the cheap present USE against the BUILD that pre-paid it (Bennett depth as the hidden axis behind V4's work-slope).

title: Results = RERUN (the calibration)
claim: Our RESULTS reproduce laws the field owns: V4=token-complexity (2503.01141); V5=which-complexity (2504.01935) + the serial-computation THEOREM (2402.12875). The rerun IS the calibration -- on thesis.

title: The FLAG (surviving white-space)
claim: The composition no region holds: cost-as-SIGNAL + black-box/substrate-agnostic + the chronometric inversion (V6) + the DPI floor. An assembly of known parts, validated by reproducing named laws.
demotions: 'three zero-prior-art moves' -> the honesty-law (~reject-option) and rediscovery-as-validation (~Cronbach-Meehl 1955) have ancestors; the JOIN survives, the primitives don't

title: The threat to the pixel
claim: Faithfulness decay / reasoning-horizon k*: reasoning tokens stop causally mattering at ~70-85% of the chain. The camera's pixel may be partly fake past a horizon -- Pav's 'sharpness can never be 1', given a number.

title: V9b - the resistance tax graduates (override tax measured, un-clipped)
claim: Graduation of V9 (TRUE-hint control + prime-looking semiprime lure + 2 tiers + 4 reps; 448 calls). PILOT FIX: 512 is the HIGH-tier reasoning BUDGET, not a max_tokens cap -- xhigh un-clips it (up to ~6144). KEEP (corroborated): a false named hint imposes a MEASURED override tax over a clean baseline -- FALSE-NEUTRAL=+302 reasoning tokens (xhigh, p<.001, 14/14 seeds); a TRUE hint instead SHORTCUTS (-136). The attacker TRAPDOOR survives at ~1:30 (+10 input -> ~+300 hidden reasoning). A genuinely PRIME-LOOKING lure CAPTURES (12/112, call-level Fisher p=0.029) where V9's weak lure got 0 -- demoting V9's 'robust to being fooled'.
demotions: DEMOTE (codex+gemini CONVERGED) '+438 = pure override' -> '+438 is the helpful-vs-adversarial pointer SWING, NOT pure override: TRUE_HINT also SHORTCUTS the search (collapses to 1 chain). The clean tax is FALSE-NEUTRAL=+302'
DEMOTE 'attacker ratio 1:42' -> '~1:30' (1:42 mixed a FALSE-vs-NEUTRAL input delta with a FALSE-vs-TRUE reasoning delta)

DEMOTE 'more budget rationalizes the lure / break point inverted' -> HYPOTHESIS ONLY: the predicted budget-exhaustion break point did NOT appear; higher xhigh capture is NOT significant (Fisher p=0.11, 4 vs 11) and most xhigh captures used ~512 tok (not the long tail)

prime-looking capture demotes V9's 'robust' but is seed-clustered (7 vs 2 seeds) = not a stable population rate; 'high pins HARD at 512' -> 'plateaus at 512 (one 1024 exception); ceilings are observed plateaus'. NEXT=V9c negative-hints ('answer is NOT named X') to isolate truth/falsehood without the search-space confound

title: V9c - negative-hint isolation (shortcut removed; override still confounded)
claim: V9c (480 calls @ xhigh, 30 seeds): to fix V9b's confound (a positive TRUE hint SHORTCUTS the 6-chain prime search), use NEGATIVE hints ('answer is NOT named X') that force the full search. KEEP: the negative form REMOVES the shortcut -- TRUE_NEG-NEUTRAL=+2.4 (NS, p=.86), TRUE_POS-NEUTRAL=-145 -> V9b's +438 decomposes into a -145 positive shortcut + a true override (both reviewers confirm). The TRAPDOOR survives ~1:100 (+11 input -> +1201 reasoning). A false elimination of the answer is near-unfoolable (119/120) but enormously expensive to refute (+1246, un-clipped). DEMOTED: '+1246 = pure override' does NOT survive.
demotions: DEMOTE (gemini UNSOUND / codex overclaims-remain) '+1246 = pure override' -> 'a false-ELIMINATION contradiction tax conflating falsehood + answer-chain SALIENCE (FALSE_NEG names the ANSWER, TRUE_NEG a cheap-discard lure) + 0-SOLUTION PARADOX (eliminating the unique prime forces an impossible state -> the model loops, paradox-panic). generic pure override UNPROVEN'

DEMOTE 'override BIGGER than V9b pointer (+1246 vs +302)' -> '~4x NUMERICALLY but mechanisms differ (pointer=soft 1-solution contradiction; elimination=0-solution paradox)'; 'unpaid-tax capture' DROPPED (n=1; 40 correct calls also used 512 tok). NEXT=V9d 2-PRIME RELEASE VALVE (gemini: 2 primes, eliminate one; cheap pivot=paradox-panic, agonize=real override) + same-named-chain/verify-all (codex) = the clean isolation

title: V9d - 2-prime release valve (override survives; escape enables capture)
claim: V9d (480 calls @ xhigh, 30 seeds): tests gemini's V9c 'paradox-panic' hypothesis. Matched 1P/2P panes differ only in the 6th chain (a non-prime vs a 2nd prime A<B = a valid ESCAPE); FALSE_NEG ('NOT named B') falsely eliminates the largest prime. KEEP (both reviewers): the OVERRIDE SURVIVES the escape -- FALSE_NEG_2P-NEUTRAL_2P=+1093 (p<1e-7) even with an escape prime available -> V9c's cost is NOT a 0-solution-only artifact. An ESCAPE ENABLES capture: 9.3% take the valve (smaller prime) vs 0/112 NEUTRAL (Fisher p=6.5e-4) = genuine hint-obedience; without an escape the model resists 100% (incl. the paradox case, paying +1620). The lie lands only when there's somewhere cheap to land.
demotions: DEMOTE (codex+gemini) 'gemini paradox hypothesis LARGELY REFUTED' -> 'only the 0-solution-ONLY explanation is refuted; the paradox component (+373/+539, CI[-56,+999], p=.25) is an UNDERPOWERED ~25% inflation, not zero'

DROP 'capture = the unpaid tax (n=10)' -> base-rate illusion: 36/98 CORRECT calls also used ~512 tok (the modal bucket), not capture-predictive. SALIENCE still active (FALSE_NEG names the answer B) -> +1093 = a false-elimination-of-the-NAMED-answer tax, not generic; infra failures unbiased (temporal, seeds 27-29). NEXT=V9e VERIFY_ALL same-named-chain (TRUE_POS_B vs FALSE_NEG_B on trace-correct) = the convergent endpoint isolating pure falsehood
